Specification: This module specifies the Car Talk balance-scale puzzle about breaking an N-pound stone into P integer-weight pieces so that any integral weight from 1 through N can be weighed using a balance. It models candidate breaks as nondecreasing functions from 1..P to 1..N, defines when a target weight is representable by placing some pieces on each side of the scale, and characterizes solutions as breaks that represent every weight in 1..N. The spec is not a transition system with variables or temporal behavior; instead it is a mathematical specification intended for TLC evaluation of the set of all solutions, with an auxiliary operator that expands each solution into explicit weighing instructions.
IfThenElse: IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + Sum(f, S \ {x})
TupleConstructor: << w, Image(PiecesFor(w, B)[1], B), Image(PiecesFor(w, B)[2], B) >>
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE ST \in (SUBSET (1..P)) \X (SUBSET (1..P)) : IsRepresentation(w, B, ST[1], ST[2])
